 Specimen Grips
Depending on the testing task, a universal testing machine must be equipped with different specimen grips such as clamping fixtures, bending fixtures, peel fixtures, compression platens or T-slot platens. We present a selection of accessories for tensile, compression, bending and peel tests on this page. If you are missing the desired test accessories, please contact us. We will find the right solution for you.
